Optional module — how to use it

To enable fluid display type on a marketing or documentation surface, import the optional module after actual.css in the project's stylesheet entry point. The module does not change anything in the core: it adds three size tokens and three classes. Body text, app UI, and the default prose scale are not affected. Projects that do not need fluid display type do nothing — the optional module is not part of the default bundle.
